literal: He who fears his wife will indeed fear, at all times, doing good deeds to good people.
translation: He who stands in fear of his wife will always shrink from performing noble deeds for virtuous people.
modern: தன் மனைவிக்கு அஞ்சி வாழ்பவன், நல்லவர்களுக்கு நல்ல உதவிகளைச் செய்வதற்கு எப்போதும் பயப்படுவான்.
explanation: This couplet explains how domestic submissiveness destroys a man's social and moral agency. A man who is dominated by and fears his wife (இல்லாளை அஞ்சுவான்) loses his independence to act righteously. Consequently, he will always hesitate and fear (அஞ்சும்) to perform charitable or noble deeds (நல்ல செயல்) for worthy, good people (நல்லார்க்கு). The particle 'மற்று' emphasizes the certainty of this moral paralysis.
